entities.name: Tymna the Weaver
entities.description: Legendary human cleric of Theros, a mortal master of the magic of the Fates, blinded in a chariot accident.

entities.name: Battlewise of Meletis
entities.description: Order of tacticians in which Tymna once served.

events.summary: A chariot accident cut short Tymna's career of victories and left her blind.
events.quote: A career already filled with victories was cut short by a chariot accident, leaving her blind.

relations.quote: She once served among the Battlewise of Meletis
